    Slow-cooker beef bourguignon stoup

Slow-cooker beef bourguignon stoup
Fresh Ideas Image
Fresh Ideas
Slow-cooker beef bourguinon stoup
Prep
Preparation time is 10minutes
10m
Cook
Cook time is 4hours 25minutes
4hr25m
Serves
Serve is for 6 people
6
Difficulty
Difficulty level: 2 out of 4
13 Ingredients
Number of servings
6

    2 tbs extra virgin olive oil
    2tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
    700g chuck beef steak, cut into 2cm pieces
    700grams chuck beef steak, cut into 2cm pieces
    125g Woolworths middle bacon, rind removed, chopped
    125grams Woolworths middle bacon, rind removed, chopped
    200g button mushrooms, halved
    200grams button mushrooms, halved
    3 French shallots, quartered
    3 French shallots, quartered
    3 cloves garlic, finely chopped
    3 cloves garlic, finely chopped
    1/4 cup Woolworths tomato paste
    1/4 cup Woolworths tomato paste
    3 beef stock cubes, crumbled
    3 beef stock cubes, crumbled
    250g baby potatoes, quartered
    250grams baby potatoes, quartered
    410g canned Woolworths whole baby carrots, drained
    410grams canned Woolworths whole baby carrots, drained
    1/4 punnet rosemary, chopped
    1/4 punnet rosemary, chopped
    1/4 bunch continental parsley, chopped
    1/4 bunch continental parsley, chopped
    1 lemon, zested and juiced
    1 lemon, zested and juiced 

Description
Thick, rich, and deeply savoury. This comforting stoup brings classic French flavours straight to your bowl and is the ultimate cold-weather cure.
Method
Step 1 of 3
Heat 1 tbs oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Season beef with freshly ground black pepper. Add beef to pan and cook for 8-10 minutes or until browned. Transfer to a 5L slow cooker. Add bacon, mushrooms and shallots to the same pan and cook, stirring, for 8-10 minutes or until golden.
Step 2 of 3
Add garlic and tomato paste to pan and cook for a further 2 minutes or until combined. Add stock, potato and 6 cups boiling water to pan. Bring to a simmer. Add to beef in slow cooker. Cook for 4 hours on high or 8 hours on low, or until the meat is tender, adding carrots for the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Step 3 of 3
Combine rosemary, parsley, lemon zest and juice, and remaining oil. Ladle stoup into serving bowls. Serve sprinkled with rosemary gremolata.
